import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4a8f1c81.py'
# create source via python
src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The diagonal guide lines identify a repeating diagonal color pattern.
    # Their offsets are separated by five; alternate the two guide colors.
    vals = {}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                vals[(c-r) % 10] = v
    # fill missing residue positions by repeating nearest guide color at 5-cell intervals
    colors = [vals.get(i, 0) for i in range(10)]
    for i in range(10):
        if colors[i] == 0:
            colors[i] = colors[(i+5)%10] or colors[(i-5)%10]
    return [[colors[(c-r)%10] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(src)
exec(src)
grid=[[0]*18 for _ in range(18)]
for r in range(5,18):grid[r][r-5]=5
for r in range(10,18):grid[r][r-10]=6
out=transform(grid)
print(out[0])
